case_name: Regional Manager & Anr. v Pawan Kumar Dubey
respondent:
Pawan Kumar Dubey
Supreme Court of India

8 March 1976
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION: Civil Appeal No. 1844/1975. (Arising as an appeal by special leave from the judgment and order Dt. 17 July 1974 of the Allahabad High Court in special appeal No. 121 of 1974)
The Judgment was delivered by : M. Hameedullah Beg , J.
1. This appeal by special leave granted to the Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, challenges the findings of a learned single Judge, affirmed by a Division Bench of the Allahabad High Court holding that the respondent, Pawan Kumar Dubey, was reverted from the post of a Senior Station Incharge, in which he was officiating, to his substantive post of a Junior Station Incharge by means of an order dated 20-2-1973 passed as a measure of punishment inflicted upon him for alleged misconduct indicated by an adverse entry communicated to him by a letter dated 25th January, 1973. His juniors, it was found, were still officia
facts: The appeal by special leave granted to the Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, challenges the findings of a learned single Judge, affirmed by a Division Bench of the Allahabad High Court holding that the respondent, Pawan Kumar Dubey, was reverted from the post of a Senior Station Incharge, in which he was officiating, to his substantive post of a Junior Station Incharge.

His juniors, it was found, were still officiating in posts of Senior Station Incharge. The respondent's chances of promotion were said to be adversely affected by the reason given for the reversion in the impugned order: that the respondent was 'not fit yet' for the higher post.
The Allahabad High Court had followed what it considered to be the ratio decidendi of Sughar Singh's case 1973 Indlaw SC 65 (supra), the last case of this Court available at the time.

Special leave to appeal was sought in the case before us on the ground that Sughar Singh's case 1973 Indlaw SC 65 (supra) had been misunderstood by the High Court and required some elucidation by this Court.

The question to be determined was assumed to be one of law only. The appeal was, therefore, to be heard on the special leave paper 'Book with such additional documents from the record of the case as the parties may choose to file.
issues: Whether the order dated 20-2-1973 passed by the Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, was one amounting to award of a punishment or not.
Whether the respondent's reversion from the post of Senior Station Incharge to his substantive post of Junior Station Incharge was a measure of punishment inflicted upon him for alleged misconduct.
petitioner_arguments: The Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, argued that the order dated 20-2-1973 passed by them was one amounting to award of a punishment and not a mere reversion.

They contended that the respondent's reversion from the post of Senior Station Incharge to his substantive post of Junior Station Incharge was a measure of punishment inflicted upon him for alleged misconduct.
respondent_arguments: The respondent, Pawan Kumar Dubey, argued that the order dated 20-2-1973 passed by the Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, was not one amounting to award of a punishment but a mere reversion.
He contended that his reversion from the post of Senior Station Incharge to his substantive post of Junior Station Incharge was not a measure of punishment inflicted upon him for alleged misconduct.
court_reasoning: The Court held that the order dated 20-2-1973 passed by the Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, was one amounting to award of a punishment and not a mere reversion.

It was observed that the respondent's reversion from the post of Senior Station Incharge to his substantive post of Junior Station Incharge was a measure of punishment inflicted upon him for alleged misconduct.
holding: The Court held that the order dated 20-2-1973 passed by the Regional Manager of U.P. State Road Transport Corporation, Allahabad, was one amounting to award of a punishment and not a mere reversion.

It was observed that the respondent's reversion from the post of Senior Station Incharge to his substantive post of Junior Station Incharge was a measure of punishment inflicted upon him for alleged misconduct.
